articles.title: Manchester United's Defensive Woes Continue Under Michael Carrick
articles.summary: Former Manchester United captain and current Sky Sports pundit Roy Keane has criticized Michael Carrick's leadership following the team's 4-4 draw against Aston Villa.
articles.content: Manchester United's defensive woes have sparked widespread criticism, and none more so than from a familiar face - Roy Keane. Keane, a former Manchester United captain and current Sky Sports pundit, unleashed a scathing attack on Michael Carrick's leadership following the team's 4-4 draw against Aston Villa at Old Trafford. The match was an eight-goal thriller that saw Aston Villa take a two-goal lead in just four minutes, leaving many wondering how the Red Devils would recover. United did stage a remarkable comeback to level the score before halftime but their fortunes took another downturn immediately after the restart, with Aston Villa taking a 4-2 lead. Keane's criticism of Carrick continued in his post-match interview, where he expressed frustration with the manager's vague statements. Keane claimed that Carrick talks a lot but doesn't say enough about the team's issues, saying "He keeps saying we need to tighten up and there's things we need to work on." The former captain emphasized that words are not enough, urging the team to take immediate action to address their defensive problems. The Manchester United squad has faced intense scrutiny following a dismal start to the season, with Keane pointing out the poor statistics. He questioned what specific changes Carrick and his coaching staff plan to implement in the coming weeks, demanding more concrete solutions rather than vague promises. Despite his harsh words, Keane acknowledged that the team showed resilience in their late fightback against Aston Villa, praising their determination to keep going despite a poor performance. However, he stressed that footballing ability is just as important as spirit, and the team needs to improve drastically if they are to succeed this season. The Manchester United team is facing an uphill battle this season, as evident from their recent performance against Aston Villa. The match was marred by defensive errors, which Keane described as "some bits so, so bad. Despite managing to salvage a point from the game, the overall display was far from satisfactory. The team's struggles have been well-documented, with many expressing frustration over their inability to hold onto leads. Matheus Cunha, one of United's forwards, captured the mood in the dressing room perfectly when he admitted to feeling so tired" and "so disappointed." His words reflected the collective sentiment among the players. The team's poor performance has left them languishing in the relegation zone, with only one Premier League victory this season. Their inability to fix their defensive issues is becoming a major concern for manager Michael Carrick. With each passing game, the pressure on him to improve the team's fortunes is mounting. A drastic change in the dugout may soon be on the cards if Carrick fails to address the team's weaknesses and instill confidence into his players. The club's hierarchy will be closely monitoring the situation, and a decision could be made to bring in fresh leadership to turn things around. articles.title: Tampa Bay Buccaneers Lose 27-24 to Chicago Bears in Week 9
articles.summary: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers fell short of a comeback victory against the Chicago Bears due to their struggling offense despite forcing five total turnovers.
articles.content: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers suffered a heartbreaking loss to the Chicago Bears in Week 9, falling short 27-24 on a last-second field goal by Cairo Santos. In a surprising turn of events, the Bucs' defense transformed from listless to dominant after a lackluster first quarter, restricting Bears quarterback Caleb Williams to one of his worst performances in the NFL. The Buccaneers forced an impressive five total turnovers, including four crucial interceptions off Williams, which set the stage for a potential comeback. The momentum generated by the defensive efforts was unfortunately not matched by the offense, which struggled to capitalize on favorable field position despite reaching the red zone on 40% of its attempts. Additionally, Tampa Bay committed two costly turnovers that hindered their chances of success. A closer look at the game reveals an intriguing dichotomy between the Bucs' defense and offense. While the defense displayed a remarkable turnaround from their initial struggles, the offense was unable to translate defensive efforts into points, ultimately surrendering the game-winning field goal after the Bears' quarterback Caleb Williams had his worst outing in the NFL. The Bucs' pass offense struggled to capitalize on the numerous turnovers forced by their defense, particularly in the passing game. Despite completing 75% of his passes for 112 yards in the first two drives, quarterback Williams' accuracy and yardage plummeted significantly in the remaining part of the game. One notable aspect was the inability of the Bucs offense to convert interceptions into points, with Baker Mayfield's unit managing only three points off the five turnovers. Furthermore, they even surrendered a pick-six after picking off Williams for the fourth time, highlighting their struggles to capitalize on defensive efforts. The defense did its part in giving the offense one final chance to tie the game or take the lead, forcing a fumble by rookie outside linebacker on Chicago's 17-yard line with under four minutes left. The Bucs capitalized on this opportunity and tied the game at 24-24 after a Bucky Irving rush touchdown. However, the defense ultimately failed to hold up against the Bears' offense, allowing a long completion that put them in field goal range. This led to a 38-yard field goal by the Bears that sealed their victory with a score of 27-24. The struggles of the pass offense were particularly evident throughout the game, as they failed to live up to expectations despite the team's strong performance in terms of turnovers and defensive efforts. The Buccaneers' rushing game showed some signs of life despite not quite matching its previous performances. Bucky Irving was a bright spot in this area, managing to rack up 97 yards on 20 carries throughout the contest. Irving's efforts were also rewarded with two touchdowns for Tampa Bay. However, Kenneth Gainwell struggled to make an impact, gaining only 16 yards on five attempts. This limited his contribution to the team's overall rushing total of 28 carries against a more considerable number of pass plays. Baker Mayfield had some notable moments during the game, including a long completion to Tez Johnson that showed promise. Nevertheless, Mayfield was also responsible for several key mistakes that hurt Tampa Bay's chances. A late third-quarter interception by Jaylon Johnson proved particularly costly, ultimately sealing the team's fate in the loss. The Buccaneers' offense as a whole struggled with consistency and focus throughout the game, including issues on both sides of the line. The tight ends and offensive linemen committed five false start penalties, while receivers like Tez Johnson and Ted Hurst dropped crucial passes that could have made a difference. The Buccaneers' decision to give Baker Mayfield a $165 million contract before the season began has raised eyebrows given his performance so far. Mayfield's play this season has not justified such a massive payday, despite the fact that he is being paid like one of the best players in the NFL. He is expected to elevate the play of those around him, but his interceptions against the Bears look similar to those thrown by undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels earlier in the season. Mayfield's pick-six against the Bears ultimately made the difference in a one-score game, mirroring a similar mistake he made against Cincinnati. With limited easy completions from Zac Robinson, Mayfield is struggling to lead a winning offense, highlighting his individual limitations. articles.title: Nvidia CEO's Close Relationship with Megaspeed Executant Raises Security Concerns
articles.summary: US intelligence officials believe a senior executive at Megaspeed has been passing information to Beijing.
articles.content: A senior executive at Megaspeed has been embroiled in a controversy surrounding her alleged close relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The New York Times reported last month that US intelligence officials believe Alice Huang was passing information to Beijing, sparking concerns about potential security breaches. Megaspeed's ties to Nvidia have come under scrutiny before, as US authorities investigated whether the company and its Malaysian affiliate were helping Chinese businesses gain access to Nvidia's AI chips in violation of US export controls. It remains unclear when Huang first met Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, but public appearances suggest a close relationship between them. The Nvidia chief and Huang were spotted together at industry events, including a 2024 Computex Taipei trade show where they were pictured with other technology executives at a bar in a LinkedIn post from AI company NetThunder. A Taiwanese media outlet also captured footage of the pair leaving a Taipei restaurant alongside other executives in May 2025. These public appearances have raised questions about Huang's role and influence within Megaspeed, as well as her connections to Nvidia and its CEO. Despite these concerns, little is known about Alice Huang beyond her professional background and affiliations. Huang Le Limited, a company based in the British Virgin Islands, was granted ownership of Megaspeed's Singaporean entity after she took on the roles of director and managing director at the company. This transfer occurred just before Huang resigned from both positions on November 10, when Cang Yang also stepped down as a director. Corporate filings confirm this change in ownership. The handover of shares was part of a series of transactions involving Megaspeed's ownership structure. The Singapore entity is now solely owned by Swiftdata, another company incorporated in Singapore. This transfer took place on the same day that Huang Le Limited relinquished its stake, November 10. It appears that Swiftdata has maintained control over Megaspeed since then. Megaspeed was formed after 7Road International HK Limited split off its Singaporean subsidiary, according to reports. Prior to her time at Megaspeed, Huang worked as an executive director at a Shanghai investment fund with ties to state-backed companies and one that had backed 7Road. The investigation into Megaspeed by the Singapore Police is ongoing, but they have declined to comment further on the matter. Nvidia has maintained that Jensen Huang's interactions with Alice Huang were routine business dealings, and not unusual or unexpected. This assertion was echoed by John Rizzo, a company spokesperson, who stated that meetings with customers are part of a CEO's job and that Jensen talks regularly with thousands of customer executives every year. The Nvidia CEO himself addressed the situation in an interview with Bloomberg, stating that his relationship and interactions with Alice Huang were related to Megaspeed and completely normal. In a separate note to Nvidia staff on Sunday, Jensen admitted to being unfaithful to his wife, but did not mention Alice Huang or address their reported relationship directly. articles.title: United Nations Climate Summit Convenes in Antalya, Turkey
articles.summary: World leaders, delegates, and climate activists have converged on Antalya, Turkey, for a crucial United Nations climate summit aimed at tackling the growing threat of global warming.
articles.content: World leaders, delegates, and climate activists have converged on Antalya, Turkey, for a crucial United Nations climate summit aimed at tackling the growing threat of global warming. The conference, known as COP31, comes at a critical juncture, with the world reeling from a devastating year of extreme weather events. Rising temperatures have triggered deadly heatwaves in Europe and other regions, while catastrophic floods in Nepal are just one example of the devastating consequences of climate change. The sheer scale of these disasters has left many wondering if current efforts to curb emissions are sufficient. The summit is also being held against the backdrop of a significant disruption to global energy supplies. The war in Iran has effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz, causing global prices of gasoline and oil to skyrocket. This sudden increase in costs is having far-reaching consequences, with industries that rely on these products, such as fertilizers and pesticides, feeling the pinch. Governments are under pressure to rethink their energy policies, investing more heavily in renewable sources like wind and solar power. The urgency of this task cannot be overstated, given the catastrophic effects of climate change. Scientists warn that if greenhouse gas emissions continue to rise at current levels, global temperatures will exceed 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels. The Paris Agreement, signed in 2015, set a goal of limiting temperature rises to 1.5°C by this point. However, it is now clear that achieving this target is highly unlikely. This has significant implications for international climate negotiations, which are already struggling to make progress on reducing emissions and transitioning to cleaner energy sources. As the UN climate summit gets underway in Turkey, Turkish Environment Minister Murat Kurum has expressed his concerns about the world's ability to meet its 1.5-degree temperature target. According to Kurum, it is now clear that this goal will be exceeded. The COP31 president has emphasized the need for action rather than setting new targets, and has announced an "Action Agenda" aimed at reducing greenhouse gas emissions. This agenda includes measures such as decreasing methane levels and building climate-resilient cities. Electrification is also a key focus area, with a goal of increasing electricity use from renewable sources like solar and wind to 35% by 2035. The summit will see delegates negotiating over the next two weeks on various issues, including helping poorer countries adapt to rising temperatures and transition away from fossil fuels. This has significant implications for international climate negotiations, which are already struggling to make progress on reducing emissions and transitioning to cleaner energy sources. The summit is taking place against a backdrop of criticism surrounding previous gatherings, where little agreement was reached on cutting greenhouse gas emissions. The final texts of the agreements at COP30 in Brazil and COP29 in Azerbaijan failed to mention fossil fuels, despite delegates agreeing to transition away from them at COP28 in Dubai. The United States' absence from the summit is also notable, given its status as the world's second-largest polluter after China. President Donald Trump withdrew the U.S. from climate negotiations during his first term and again when he took office for a second time in January 2025. The United Nations climate summit, COP31, has convened in Antalya, Turkey, amidst growing concerns over extreme weather patterns worldwide. In a departure from previous summits, Turkey and Australia are co-hosting COP31 after initially contesting the hosting rights. As a compromise, Turkey is officially hosting the event while Australia leads the negotiations. However, both countries have faced criticism for their reliance on coal, which has raised eyebrows among climate activists. Despite these challenges, U.N. Climate Change Executive Secretary Simon Stiell remains optimistic that COP31 will yield significant progress in addressing global warming. articles.title: President Donald Trump acknowledges harsh immigration policies may have cost him votes in midterms
articles.summary: Trump stated that mass deportations had negative consequences for his campaign and claimed his administration's removal of undocumented immigrants was too severe.
articles.content: President Donald Trump has acknowledged that his immigration policies were overly harsh and may have cost him votes in the midterm elections. In a recent interview on CBS' "60 Minutes, Trump stated that mass deportations of undocumented immigrants had negative consequences for his campaign. Trump claimed that his administration's removal of undocumented immigrants, even those who had not committed serious crimes, was too severe. He cited the example of individuals with good jobs who had only one minor infraction - entering the country without proper documentation. This policy, Trump suggested, alienated some voters and ultimately hurt his chances in the midterms. In the same interview, Trump hinted at a willingness to revisit immigration policies and work towards finding common ground with Democrats. When asked if a potential deal could involve granting legal status to undocumented workers, Trump did not rule out this possibility. However, he also emphasized that any agreement would need to be crafted with caution, balancing competing interests within his own party. Trump's comments on immigration suggest a shift in approach, one where he is willing to reconsider the tough stance taken by his administration on deportations. He noted that many people, including those who identify as being on the pretty far right, share a nuanced view of immigration and may be open to compromise on this issue. The former President's views on mass deportations have taken a surprising turn, as he now describes them as too tough and detrimental to his electoral prospects. This shift in stance comes after years of promoting policies aimed at removing undocumented immigrants from the country. Trump has also made significant changes to his administration, including promoting Stephen Miller to White House chief of staff. Miller was instrumental in developing the mass deportation policy that Trump had previously championed. The move replaces Susie Wiles, who held the position until now. In an attempt to deflect blame for last week's midterm losses, Trump attributed the Republican party's defeat to bad messaging. He also downplayed the impact of the Iran war on the country's economic woes, suggesting that the media failed to adequately report on his administration's successes. During a recent conversation, President Trump downplayed his preoccupation with his net worth, stating that he devotes almost no time to it. When asked how this aligns with his reputation for being business-savvy, he simply replied I don't care" about the value of his assets. Trump also discussed his involvement in World Liberty Financial, a cryptocurrency company co-founded by two of his sons. As one of the owners, Trump claimed that he has no knowledge of the company's operations and does not participate in discussions about finances with his sons. This lack of engagement is remarkable given the significant stakes involved, including investments from Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan. This arrangement has raised eyebrows among observers, who have questioned whether foreign investors in World Liberty Financial believe they are buying influence by investing in a company tied to the Trump family. In response to these concerns, Trump maintained that he knows nothing about the workings of the company and is not involved in its decision-making processes. articles.title: Jon Rahm Claims 11th Title in 92 Starts at Abu Dhabi Championship
articles.summary: Jon Rahm has won his 11th title in just 92 starts at the Abu Dhabi Championship, a significant milestone in his career.
articles.content: Jon Rahm has made a triumphant return to the DP World Tour, claiming his 11th title in just 92 starts at the Abu Dhabi Championship. The Spaniard's victory marks a significant milestone in his career, putting him alongside Tiger Woods and Seve Ballesteros as one of the fastest players to achieve this feat. This achievement is all the more impressive given that Rahm has had to navigate a challenging period in his golfing journey. Rahm's performance at Yas Links GC was nothing short of spectacular, with the golfer reaching 23 under par for the tournament. His dominance on the course ultimately led him to a two-stroke victory over Tyrrell Hatton, who finished as runner-up. The Abu Dhabi Championship is one of the most prestigious events on the DP World Tour calendar, and Rahm's win has added significant weight to his resume just a week ahead of the DP World Tour Championship. This title also breaks a tie with Hatton for the most Rolex Series events won by an individual. Rahm was visibly emotional when speaking about his victory, expressing gratitude for the opportunity to return to form on the DP World Tour. He acknowledged that it has been some time since he has played well in a tour event and that this win is all the more special given his recent challenges. In reflection of his performance, Rahm highlighted a standout shot from the back nine as one of the highlights of his round, describing it as "a contender for shot of the year" for him. Rahm's impressive performance at the Abu Dhabi Championship has not gone unnoticed, and it's given him a glimmer of hope for the DP World Tour Championship next week. According to the latest standings, Rahm would need Rory McIlroy to finish worse than second place and Eugenio Chacarra to finish outside eighth place in order to claim the title. This is no small feat considering Rahm has won the DP World Tour Championship on three previous occasions, including a win in 2019 that also earned him the Race to Dubai. With his current form, it's clear that he still has what it takes to compete at the highest level, and this newfound opportunity may just give him an extra boost of motivation. In fact, Rahm himself expressed surprise at being given a chance to win the championship, saying "I didn't think I would ever have a chance to win it" in a recent statement. However, he's now looking forward to the challenge ahead, and sees his current position as a welcome bonus. With only one week left before the DP World Tour Championship, Rahm will need to stay focused and maintain his momentum if he hopes to emerge victorious. His playing partners, including Hatton and Francesco LaPorta, will undoubtedly be putting pressure on him from behind, but Rahm has shown that he's more than capable of rising to the occasion. Rahm's recent performance at the Abu Dhabi Championship has been nothing short of impressive, with standout shots like his 184-yard approach at the 15th hole catching the eye. With this level of skill and determination, it's clear that Rahm is a force to be reckoned with on the course, and he'll stop at nothing to claim his fourth DP World Tour Championship title. Rahm's victory at the Abu Dhabi Championship has catapulted him to sixth place in the season-long Race to Dubai standings, just four rounds away from the championship. McIlroy, who narrowly missed out on winning, remains in contention for a record eighth title despite falling short of his goal. His third-place finish at 19 under has seen him leapfrog Patrick Reed and move into second position in the standings. Reed's hopes of retaining his top spot in the Race to Dubai have been dealt a blow after being overtaken by McIlroy, while Casey Jarvis and Aaron Rai round out the top five. Rahm's impressive win has brought him significantly closer to challenging for the title. McIlroy is now eyeing a major comeback as he prepares to compete at the DP World Tour Championship next week in Dubai. The six-time major champion remains confident of his chances, citing his goal of winning the championship and closing the gap on Eugenio Chacarra and Patrick Reed. With this strong showing, McIlroy's determination is evident, and it will be exciting to see how he performs as he bids for a record eighth Race to Dubai title. articles.title: Nursing Simulation Model Aims to Improve Skills Assessment
articles.summary: A team of researchers has developed a new debriefing framework called Power in Practice that encourages reflective dialogue about the emotional impact of decisions made by practitioners.
articles.content: A new clinical simulation model is being hailed as a game-changer for nursing staff, providing a more nuanced approach to assessing their skills and professionalism. The traditional methods used in clinical simulation have focused primarily on evaluating technical skills and adherence to medical standards, often from a one-size-fits-all perspective that overlooks the complexities of nursing practice. This narrow focus has been criticized for neglecting essential aspects of care, such as building relationships with patients and managing emotions among nurses. A team of researchers has developed Power in Practice, a new debriefing framework designed to transform the way nursing simulation sessions are analyzed. This innovative approach encourages reflective dialogue about the emotional impact of decisions made by practitioners, leading to improved psychological safety and greater recognition of their leadership within the healthcare system. The research was led by Laura Macià Casòliva from Althaia, in collaboration with Carlota Riera Claret from UVic-UCC. The new clinical simulation model aims to optimize learning through a structured debriefing process. This involves a four-stage sequence: Feel, Think, See, and Move, each focusing on a different aspect of the experience. The Feel stage prioritizes emotions and psychological safety, while the Think stage emphasizes clinical reasoning and nursing knowledge. Debriefings are now being redefined as opportunities for nurses to reflect on their actions and decisions. The new framework incorporates nurse empowerment as a key goal, encouraging practitioners to explore their emotions, reflect on their thinking, recognize the impact of their actions, and identify concrete steps for improvement. Research has shown that several factors contribute to nurse empowerment, including psychological safety, positive team dynamics, confidence, autonomy, reflection, and recognition of nursing practice's impact. By applying this model, nurses can develop clinical skills while fostering adaptability, self-awareness, and independence in complex healthcare environments. The study behind the new tool analyzed nurses' experiences during the COVID-19 pandemic and simulation-based education. It highlighted the importance of psychological safety, team climate, confidence, autonomy, reflection, and recognition in empowering nurses to make informed decisions and take ownership of their practice. This model's application not only enhances clinical skills but also promotes professional growth and self-awareness among nursing staff. By prioritizing nurse empowerment, healthcare organizations can better support their employees in navigating the complexities of modern healthcare settings. The empowerment of nursing staff is a crucial aspect of modern healthcare settings, and a new clinical simulation model aims to strengthen their autonomy by framing debriefing as an opportunity for growth. This model can be applied in various scenarios, including clinical simulations, complex healthcare situations, mentoring processes, and team reflection. By adopting this approach, nurses can develop their identity, confidence, and capacity to act effectively, ultimately enhancing the quality of care provided. The effectiveness of this model in different settings requires further research, highlighting the need for continued evaluation and refinement to ensure its optimal implementation. articles.title: Setting Up a Laptop as a Secondary Display
articles.summary: Using an old laptop as a secondary display can boost productivity and multitasking capabilities.
articles.content: Adding a second monitor to your setup can significantly boost productivity and multitasking capabilities. Whether you're gaming, working or simply browsing, having an extra screen at your disposal can be a game-changer for presentations, web browsing and more. One way to achieve this is by repurposing an old laptop as a secondary display. If you have a spare laptop lying around the house, you might be able to use it without needing to invest in new hardware. However, making this work requires some adjustments on your system's settings. To start, check if your computer is compatible with this setup and consider whether you want to go for wired or wireless connectivity options. You'll need to tweak some settings on your system to ensure a smooth display extension or mirroring experience. The process involves checking the compatibility of your laptop as a secondary monitor, which can be done by following specific steps for Windows, Mac and Linux operating systems. Additionally, you may want to explore wired options via HDMI connections to see what works best for your setup. To get started, you'll need to decide on the type of connection you prefer - whether it's wireless or wired via an HDMI cable. This will determine the next steps in configuring your laptop as a secondary display and getting everything up and running smoothly. To set up your laptop as a secondary display using Windows 10 or 11, you'll need to enable Miracast on both devices. This built-in wireless casting tool allows connections between devices via Wi-Fi and requires minimal setup. On the spare laptop, navigate to Settings > System > Projecting to this PC. From there, select Optional features, then View features, before adding Wireless Display by selecting it from the list. Once installed, return to the same page and configure Wireless Display to be available for use everywhere. The next step is to open the Wireless Display app on your spare laptop. This will prepare both devices for wireless connection. Ensure that Wi-Fi is enabled on both machines, as this method relies on a stable internet connection between them. With everything set up, you can now connect your main computer to your spare laptop using Miracast. Press the Windows key + K on your main computer to access available displays, select your spare laptop from the list, and enter the PIN required for authentication. This will establish a wireless connection allowing keyboard and mouse input between devices. Once connected, you can choose to mirror or extend your display by selecting the appropriate option using Windows key + P. Keep in mind that this method may experience some lag, making it less suitable for gaming. To establish a connection between two MacBooks, both devices must be compatible and signed into the same Apple ID. The MacBook in use as the second screen must have AirPlay Receiver enabled, which can be found under System Settings > General > AirDrop & Continuity. The primary device should also be configured to allow AirPlay, with the user selecting "Current User from the options listed under Allow AirPlay for. On the secondary device, users can choose between mirroring or extended display by accessing settings. For connectivity between devices running different operating systems, a software solution is required. One option is Deskreen, a free and open-source tool that enables Wi-Fi connections between computers. To initiate a connection using Deskreen, both devices must be connected to the same Wi-Fi network. The user should then download and install the software on the main device, generating a QR code and URL for the spare laptop's browser. Once the secondary device has accessed the provided link, it will connect to the main device via Deskreen, with mirroring enabled by default. However, users seeking an extended display will need to invest in a virtual display adaptor or dummy plug" for their main computer's HDMI port. The use of software-based connections over Wi-Fi inevitably introduces some level of lag, making them less suitable for resource-intensive activities like gaming. To connect two laptops together using an HDMI connection, it's essential to note that most laptop HDMI ports are video-out only. This means plugging two devices together directly won't allow for display extension or mirroring. A solution is to use an HDMI-to-USB video capture card, which can be plugged into both laptops. The main device's HDMI cable goes into the card, while the USB end of the card connects to the spare laptop. The capture card functions as a webcam, enabling users to view the feed through their laptop's camera app or a free video app like OBS Studio. This setup is not limited to general use; it can also be applied for gaming purposes. Gamers can connect a PlayStation or Nintendo Switch console to their laptop using this method. Although there may be some lag, it is typically less than what occurs with Wi-Fi-based connections and unlikely to affect casual gamers. The versatility of repurposing an old laptop extends beyond these uses; it can also serve as a smart home hub. Engadget : https://www.engadget.com/2309277/how-to-use-laptop-second-desktop-monitor/

articles.content: President Donald Trump has announced plans to stage a political comeback despite his party's dismal performance in last week's midterm elections. The Republican Party lost control of Congress following Tuesday's vote, leaving Trump with limited influence for the remainder of his term as president. This 'lame duck' period will now span two years, significantly reducing Trump's ability to shape policy and legislation. Incoming Democratic leaders have pledged to scrutinize top officials in Trump's administration, promising to hold them accountable through investigations. The party has also threatened to prosecute certain individuals if they do not cooperate with inquiries. Trump responded to the news by taking to social media, where he expressed his discontent with the election results and their impact on the stock market, which had reportedly experienced a downturn following the vote. The appointment of Stephen Miller as Trump's new chief of staff marks a significant shift in strategy for the former president. Miller is known for his hardline stance on immigration, which has been identified by analysts as one of the key factors contributing to the Republican party's poor performance at the polls. This development comes as Democrats threaten to use their newfound control of Congress to launch investigations into Trump's administration. The party has signaled its intention to summon officials, demand documents, and hold public hearings, putting Trump and his senior aides under intense scrutiny. Among the likely subjects for investigation are the Trump family's business dealings and cryptocurrency transactions, government contracts involving billionaire Elon Musk, cuts to federal agencies, immigration enforcement, and the conduct of the Iran war. These areas have already been identified as potential targets for Democratic probes. The Democrats' ability to summon officials and demand documents gives them significant leverage in their investigations. The party has control of committees in both chambers of Congress, allowing them to put pressure on Trump's administration from multiple angles. The impeachment threat against Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth has gained momentum within Republican ranks, with some lawmakers reportedly planning to introduce a motion as early as Monday. House Minority Leader Jeffries has signaled his support for an impeachment resolution, stating that Hegseth's leadership has been detrimental to national security and the economy. The criticism centers on Hegseth's handling of the conflict in Iran, which critics argue has led to increased costs for American consumers and compromised national safety. President Trump came to Hegseth's defense over the weekend, highlighting his successes in Venezuela and Iran as evidence of his effectiveness as Secretary of Defense. Trump pointed out that the US had successfully removed Venezuelan President Nicholas Maduro from power in January, resulting in significant financial gains for the country. Attorney General Todd Blanche has vowed to vigorously defend senior members of the administration, including White House advisor Stephen Miller, should they face prosecution or impeachment proceedings. The US Congress is continuing to clash over Democrat threats of prosecution against senior administration officials. Ranking Democrat Robert Garcia on the House Oversight Committee has fired back at Attorney General Todd Blanche's vow to defend White House advisors and cabinet members. Garcia has stated that it is the role of Congress to hold the executive branch accountable, insisting that Blanche's actions are driven by a desire to shield Donald Trump's administration from scrutiny. He has vowed to investigate those committing crimes against the public and stop corruption, undeterred by potential intimidation. articles.title: Seismic Activity Uncovered in Nankai Trough Region
articles.summary: Researchers at the University of Tokyo have employed a novel radiocarbon analysis technique to examine a sediment core extracted from the Kumano Sea off Japan's coast, uncovering multiple previously unknown earthquakes.
articles.content: Researchers at the University of Tokyo have employed a novel radiocarbon analysis technique to examine a sediment core extracted from the Kumano Sea off Japan's coast. The study has uncovered multiple previously unknown earthquakes in the Nankai Trough region, where a significant earthquake is forecasted to occur in the future. The Nankai Trough is an area known for its seismic activity and history of powerful earthquakes that have triggered devastating tsunamis. In recent years, Japan's disaster preparedness and monitoring systems have significantly improved, resulting in reduced damage from natural disasters compared to the past. A more accurate understanding of historical events, including their location, scale, and recurrence, is crucial for predicting future geophysical occurrences and mitigating potential disasters. The researchers' findings aim to contribute to this goal by shedding light on previously unknown seismic activity in the region. The study's results have been published in a scientific journal, but further research is necessary to confirm the significance of these hidden earthquakes and their impact on the region's seismic profile. A team of researchers from the University of Tokyo has employed a novel radiocarbon analysis technique to examine a sediment core extracted from the Kumano Sea. This effort aims to uncover signs of past earthquakes that conventional methods have been unable to detect. The study utilized an ultrasensitive method to measure the minute amounts of carbon-14 present in ocean floor sediments, with a resolution of 1 centimeter or less. This approach revealed several new geological layers not previously visible through visual observations or other analysis techniques. These newly discovered layers are thought to have originated from submarine landslides possibly triggered by earthquakes within the Nankai Trough region. The researchers' findings suggest that multiple events may have occurred in this area, which were not identified using conventional methods. The significance of carbon-14 lies in its predictable decay rate and widespread presence in biological materials. When organisms absorb carbon-14 during their lifetime, it can be measured in samples containing plant or animal remains. This allows researchers to date samples back approximately 50,000 to 60,000 years by tracking the extent of decay. The precise measurement of carbon-14 has enabled the team to uncover hidden geological events that would have otherwise gone undetected. A 40-centimeter-long cylinder of fine-grained clayey silt was extracted from the Kumano Trough, off Japan's southeast coast. This sediment core, obtained from a deep-sea trench, contains valuable information about past geological events that have affected the region. The researchers analyzed the total organic carbon content at regular intervals along the length of the core, measuring 0.5- to 1.0-centimeter segments. By doing so, they were able to pinpoint areas where older organic carbon was found mixed with younger sediment. This mixing is indicative of seafloor disturbance caused by severe floods, storms, or submarine earthquakes. The team's findings suggest that these events left behind hidden layers of sediment, which would have otherwise gone undetected. According to the researchers, "the chemical and structural features were indistinguishable" between redeposited sediments and the underlying material. This made it difficult to identify the affected areas without further analysis. By correlating their findings with historical records of submarine earthquakes from the 13th to the 20th century, the team was able to pinpoint specific events that had caused the seafloor disturbance. The precise measurement of carbon-14 has been instrumental in uncovering these hidden geological events, allowing researchers to gain a deeper understanding of the region's seismic history. Researchers are now looking to expand their analysis beyond the Kumano Sea, seeking a more comprehensive understanding of Japan's seismic history. This endeavor is crucial for regions prone to geological activity, as it can significantly improve predictive models and help mitigate disaster risks. By studying marine sediments in greater detail, scientists aim to uncover hidden patterns and events that have shaped Japan's geological landscape over time. articles.title: Apple Forced to Adopt Standard USB Ports on iPhones
articles.summary: MacOS fails to detect USB devices due to various reasons such as damaged cords or accessories requiring more power.
articles.content: USB devices have become an essential part of our daily lives, and Apple played a significant role in popularizing them with its iconic iMac design that ditched legacy connectors. The widespread adoption of USB ports led to European Union regulations forcing Apple to adopt standard USB ports on iPhones instead of its proprietary Lightning ports. Despite the prevalence of well-behaved modern USB Mac accessories, there are instances where macOS fails to detect them, causing frustration for users who expect seamless connectivity. This issue is not unique to specific devices or brands but can occur due to various reasons such as damaged cords or accessories that require more power. The good news is that many issues related to USB device detection on Macs have known explanations and fixes. For instance, if a cord is damaged, replacing it with a new one may resolve the problem. Similarly, some accessories might not work properly if they require more power than what's available from the Mac. In most cases, macOS software issues can be resolved by checking settings or permissions. By default, macOS requires user permission for accessories to connect, which prevents malware from being injected into the system. However, this also means that users may accidentally reject a permission prompt, preventing legitimate accessories from transmitting data until they give their consent. When a USB device is not detected on a Mac, it's essential to check if charging is still working in either direction. If charging works but the device is not recognized, it could be a sign of a software issue rather than a hardware problem. Forcing macOS to re-display permission prompts can resolve issues with unrecognized devices. To do this, try unplugging and replugging in the accessory. However, to avoid future hassle, it's a good idea to check your Mac's settings under Apple menu > System Settings > Privacy & Security. In the Accessories section of these settings, you'll find options for handling new accessories: Ask for new accessories, Automatically allow when unlocked, or Always allow. While Automatically allow when unlocked is a convenient option, it may not be suitable if you're frequently away from your Mac. If changing these settings doesn't resolve the issue, check to see if macOS recognizes your device in the first place. To do this, hold down the Option key and click on Apple menu > System Information. If your accessory appears under Hardware, you can refer to the manufacturer's online support resources for troubleshooting advice. However, if your accessory is not visible or is detected but results in an error message when plugged in, there may be a more complex issue at play. One possible cause of this problem is power: some devices require more power than a Mac's USB port can supply. In such cases, you might see related messages prompting you to connect a separate power cable. If your device doesn't have a separate power cord, the issue could lie with the USB port itself. Try using alternate ports on your Mac or connecting directly if you were previously using a hub or dock as an intermediary. If power-related warnings persist, it may be worth reaching out to Apple's technical support for assistance. This could indicate that there's an underlying problem with your Mac's ability to supply power through its USB ports. If your USB device isn't showing up on your MacBook, it's essential to consider the role that hubs and docks play in this process. These devices often require their own power supplies, but even if they don't, issues can arise when multiple devices are connected through a chain of transmission. One possible solution is to ensure that macOS is fully updated by navigating to System Settings via the Apple menu and clicking on Software Update. This could help resolve any bugs or driver compatibility issues that might be interfering with your USB device's functionality. Some accessories may rely on proprietary software, which requires regular updates to function correctly. To address this, check the Mac App Store for any available updates, or visit a manufacturer's website to download the latest version of their software. External storage devices such as cards and drives must use compatible file system formats, specifically APFS, FAT, or ExFAT, in order to be recognized by your MacBook. When troubleshooting USB issues, it's also crucial to verify that you're using the correct type of cable for a device's power and bandwidth requirements. Furthermore, inspect cables and ports for any signs of damage or debris, such as lint or bent pins, which can easily block functionality. Cleaning out lint and dust with an air can or soft-tipped tool may resolve issues related to debris, while replacing damaged cables is usually necessary if you notice browning or exposed wires, a clear indication of a potential fire hazard. articles.title: Joe Burrow Leads Bengals to Fourth Straight Win
articles.summary: Joe Burrow led his team to a 34-17 win over the Falcons, throwing four touchdowns and completing over 70% of his passes for the fourth straight game.
articles.content: The NFL season is heating up, and some players are standing out as top contenders for MVP. One way to measure a player's success is by their ability to perform under pressure, and Joe Burrow did just that in his team's 34-17 win over the Falcons. Burrow had an impressive game, throwing four touchdowns and completing over 70% of his passes. This marks the fourth straight game where he has achieved this feat, a first for any player in NFL history according to recent research. The Bengals' winning streak now stands at four games, with Burrow leading the charge. Ja'Marr Chase was instrumental in the team's victory, catching 10 passes for 155 yards and scoring one touchdown. Tee Higgins also had a notable performance, making five catches for 47 yards and two scores. These two players are widely regarded as one of the best wide receiver duos in the NFL. Chase's receiving skills were on full display, showcasing his ability to catch passes from anywhere on the field. He made eight catches in the first half alone, accumulating 142 yards and scoring a touchdown. This performance was just another example of Chase's exceptional talent as a wide receiver. The Bengals' win over the Falcons marked a significant moment for Burrow, solidifying his position as one of the top contenders for MVP. His impressive completion percentage and consistent passing skills have caught the attention of fans and analysts alike. Burrow's success on the field is not solely due to his talented teammates. Despite having a strong supporting cast, including Chase and Higgins, the Bengals' running game has been inconsistent, and their defense has struggled at times. Burrow's ability to perform under pressure and lead his team to victory in these situations makes him an attractive candidate for MVP. The Bengals' winning streak is a testament to Burrow's leadership and skills as a quarterback. With four straight games of exceptional performance, he is now firmly in the running for top honors. The MVP odds are currently favoring Joe Burrow, who is neck and neck with Josh Allen in terms of betting favorites. However, there's still a long way to go before the season concludes, and several factors could affect Burrow's chances. Weather conditions will likely change as the season progresses, which may impact Burrow's performance. Additionally, his history of health issues makes it essential to monitor his situation closely. Jordan Love is another strong contender for MVP honors, but his supporting cast leaves much to be desired. The Green Bay Packers' rushing attack is currently on pace for one of the worst marks in NFL history since the 1970 merger. Despite this, Love has been nothing short of spectacular, elevating Christian Watson and Matthew Golden to stardom alongside him. They recently became the first Green Bay wide receiver duo to both reach 150+ yards and score a touchdown in the same game. Love's impressive performances have also led to some remarkable statistics. He currently holds the top spot for completions 20+ yards downfield, with an astonishing 23 successful throws. The deep ball is undoubtedly one of Love's greatest strengths, showcasing his exceptional accuracy and ability to connect with his receivers over long distances. While Love is certainly a strong contender for MVP, he faces stiff competition from other talented quarterbacks. Brock Purdy and Josh Allen have also been putting up impressive numbers, making the MVP race an extremely tight contest. Shedeur Sanders' recent performance has been less scrutinized due to the Browns' loss to the Saints. However, upon closer inspection of the box score, it's clear that Sanders had a solid game despite the final result being far from ideal. Shedeur Sanders' performance in his first start of the year in a new system was impressive despite the final result being far from ideal. One area where he excelled over Deshaun Watson is in deep throws, completing three passes of 30+ yards downfield, whereas Watson has only managed one all season. Sanders also demonstrated poise under pressure, navigating several critical moments with ease. While he wasn't perfect, avoiding sacks is a major challenge for any quarterback. He showed flashes of brilliance, including an 11-yard scramble on third-and-6 and a 5-yard run on third-and-4. As the game progressed, Sanders' performance improved significantly, throwing for 259 yards after halftime. This resurgence was particularly notable given his shaky start. His ability to bounce back from adversity is a valuable asset for any quarterback, especially one in his first start of the year in a new system. The decision to bench players due to injury is rare, and it's possible that Watson could return to the lineup soon. However, in this writer's opinion, Sanders has done enough to warrant continued playing time. His performance was impressive, and he deserves the opportunity to build on his success. In other news, the Los Angeles Rams have finally reached above .500 for the first time this season after a narrow win over the Commanders. The team's offense was led by Puka Nacua, who received an astonishing 19 targets and responded with 14 catches for 150 yards and a touchdown. Matthew Stafford's performance was underwhelming, throwing an interception that seemed to come out of nowhere. This is not an isolated incident; he has thrown nine interceptions in as many games this season. His struggles on the field are becoming increasingly concerning, and it's unclear what adjustments can be made to improve his play. The Rams' quarterback situation has become increasingly concerning as the season progresses. Matthew Stafford's struggles on the field have been evident for some time now, and it seems he is still far from finding his form from last year. Stafford's accuracy issues were particularly noticeable on Sunday, with several missed throws that could have easily resulted in touchdowns or big gains. His inability to connect with his receivers has become a recurring theme this season. One of the most striking statistics from Stafford's 2025 MVP campaign was his impressive completion rate on deep passes. However, this year he has seen a significant drop-off, completing just 24% of throws that go beyond 20 yards downfield. This is a stark contrast to last year's numbers, where he had a 43% completion rate and an impressive 10-to-1 touchdown-to-interception ratio on such throws. The Rams' defense, on the other hand, has been performing admirably this season. With Von Garrett leading the charge, they have become a formidable unit that can dominate games. The team's physical run game has also been a key factor in their recent success. While it is clear that Stafford needs to step up his game, the Rams' chances of making a deep playoff run are not entirely dependent on him. Their strong defense and solid running game provide a solid foundation for the team. However, at some point this season, the Rams will need Stafford to play like he did in 2025. If that doesn't happen, it could be a long winter in Los Angeles. The question is whether he has the ability to regain his form or if the team needs to look elsewhere for solutions. The Eagles' woes continued on Sunday with their seventh straight loss, dropping them to 2-7 this season. This puts them firmly at the bottom of the league standings and raises questions about the future of coach Nick Sirianni. Despite the struggles on offense, which included a third-string quarterback making his first start, the defense showed signs of improvement on Sunday. However, it's clear that the team needs to regroup and refocus if they hope to turn their season around. As the season progresses, teams are starting to face reality checks on their prospects. However, it's not uncommon for teams to cling to stability amidst a disappointing campaign. In some cases, a change in leadership may be inevitable, but for now, the team is holding on. The Giants' impressive 5-2-1 record is a testament to the team's resilience and adaptability. Despite J.J. McCarthy's unimpressive performance against the Eagles, he managed to avoid costly mistakes that could have sealed their fate. A narrow win for the Cowboys over the Colts was hardly convincing, given the mistakes they made during the game. Dallas lost two fumbles in critical moments, incurred several penalties, and seemed intent on sabotaging themselves. Yet, despite these lapses, they emerged victorious with a 27-23 score. The Cowboys' current record of 4-5 may seem far removed from their division leaders, but it's not impossible for them to bridge the gap. This has led some to speculate about potential roster additions ahead of the trade deadline. However, acquiring more defensive help through trades might not be the most effective solution. It's worth noting that Jerry Jones has a history of making bold moves, even when they don't make immediate sense. The possibility of trading George Pickens for additional defensive support is an intriguing one, but it remains to be seen whether this would yield tangible results. The Cowboys' chances of winning their division may not depend on being the best team overall, but rather on outlasting their competitors in a closely contested race. Their Week 17 showdown with the Giants will undoubtedly be a pivotal moment in determining which team emerges victorious. The Panthers suffered their third consecutive loss to fall to 3-5 on the season. However, this game was arguably their most competitive yet, with Bryce Young showcasing flashes of brilliance and the undermanned defense holding its own against Denver. Carolina's offense outgained the Broncos by a significant margin, amassing 353 yards compared to Denver's 312. If not for an ill-fated endzone interception, this could have been a Panthers' victory. A pivotal interception by Devon Key in the endzone has sealed another loss for the Panthers, who are still clinging to a glimmer of hope despite being in the midst of a tough NFC South division. The trade deadline is just around the corner, and teams are gearing up to make some crucial moves. The Panthers' next move will be closely watched as they attempt to turn their season around, but for now, they remain stuck with another loss on their ledger. However, it's essential to note that not all Canon cameras are compatible with this feature due to the system's reliance on Dual Pixel CMOS AF technology. Introduced by Canon in 2013, Dual Pixel CMOS AF is a sensor-based autofocus that features two photodiodes per pixel, enabling the camera to capture more detailed images. This technology is found in select iterations of the company's EOS R series cameras. The Dual Pixel 3D software utilizes this technology to convert phase differences into 3D renderings, making it possible to export images in OBJ, GLB, or MP4 video formats that showcase hyper-realistic depth and texture. This technology is a significant advancement in photography, allowing users to create stunning 3D models from their still images. However, the software's compatibility is limited to specific Canon cameras equipped with Dual Pixel CMOS AF technology. The EOS R series cameras that are compatible with this feature include several high-end models that were highly rated by critics in 2026. Canon's Dual Pixel 3D imaging software has the potential to revolutionize the way photographers capture and display their images. However, users must ensure that their camera is compatible with this feature before attempting to use it. The compatibility issue may affect some users who own Canon cameras without the necessary technology. The free 3D photo software offered by Canon is available for download on their website, but users should be aware that the company's press release includes a caveat about potential changes to the specifications and terms of use in the future. To use the software, it is currently necessary to have the 2024 version or later of Windows 11 installed on your computer. When capturing images for 3D modeling, it is essential to optimize camera settings for the best possible results. The type of subject matter also plays a crucial role in generating high-quality 3D models. Canon recommends photographing objects with matte textures and simple shapes, such as flowers, plants, ceramic items, and food with rounded forms. articles.title: US Tech Imports Pose Compatibility Risks
articles.summary: Buying technology from other countries can lead to issues with compatibility and functionality due to regional restrictions and varying hardware configurations.
articles.content: Buying technology from other countries may seem like a convenient solution when your device dies while traveling or when a product is not available locally. However, there are several drawbacks to consider before making an online purchase or buying in person during a trip. When importing devices, users often encounter restrictions that can be frustrating. For instance, the hardware configurations of certain products can vary depending on the region they were purchased in. Some devices may have features like dual SIM slots that are not available in other countries. For example, iPhones sold in China come equipped with physical SIM slots, a feature that was dropped from US models starting with the iPhone 14. This means users who purchase these phones abroad may struggle to access certain connectivity features when they return home. Additionally, some devices may have limited access to core software or tools even if they are used elsewhere. When shopping for technology from overseas markets, it's essential to research and understand any regional restrictions that may apply. This can help avoid unexpected problems with compatibility or functionality. Users who purchase devices from other regions may also face challenges in accessing warranty coverage or repair services, adding to the overall complexity of importing technology products. Purchasing technology products from other countries can be fraught with challenges, particularly when it comes to compatibility issues. One of the key concerns is cellular bands, which vary by region and country. For instance, a phone bought in another country may not work on the US' 5G network, resulting in limited access to carrier-specific features like VoLTE or Wi-Fi Calling. This can be a significant problem for individuals who plan to use their devices as main phones, making it essential to check the compatibility of any device before purchasing from outside one's home region. The issue is not limited to phones alone. Other tech products, such as laptops, can also pose problems when bought from abroad. For example, laptop keyboards may have different layouts depending on the country where they were purchased, with French keyboards featuring the AZERTY layout and QWERTY versions being less common in those markets. Moreover, power issues must be taken into account, including the need for adaptors due to differing plug types and voltages, which can range from 120V at 60Hz in the US to 220-240V at 50Hz in most of Europe and Asia. When shopping online from abroad, buyers must factor in additional costs such as import duties and shipping charges. The removal of the $800 de minimis exemption for international parcels by the US has increased the financial burden on consumers. With high shipping costs and potential tax liabilities, purchasing technology from overseas can be a costly affair.
